verdict.rationale: MotherDuck has a dedicated pricing docs page covering the 7-day free trial and the Lite plan (10 GB free storage plus free monthly compute). It also documents per-second billing and fixed instance sizes from Pulse through Giga, which supply the structure for a cost estimate. The evidence contains no actual per-unit compute or storage rates and no cost calculator. The usage views and billing dashboard only help after you commit, not before. Missing for 10: published per-unit compute and storage prices per instance size, a pre-purchase cost estimator or worked billing examples, and independent confirmation that bills are predictable.
